1.web: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
1.asv: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

2.web: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
2.asv: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.

3.web: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
3.asv: For I know my transgressions; And my sin is ever before me.

4.web: Against you, and you only, have I sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight; that you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
4.asv: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, And done that which is evil in thy sight; That thou mayest be justified when thou speakest, And be clear when thou judgest.

5.web: Behold, I was born in iniquity. In sin my mother conceived me.
5.asv: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity; And in sin did my mother conceive me.

6.web: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
6.asv: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts; And in the hidden part thou wilt make me to know wisdom.

7.web: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
7.asv: Purify me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

8.web: Let me hear joy and gladness, That the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
8.asv: Make me to hear joy and gladness, That the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

9.web: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
9.asv: Hide thy face from my sins, And blot out all mine iniquities.

10.web: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
10.asv: Create in me a clean heart, O God; And renew a right spirit within me.

11.web: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your holy Spirit from me.
11.asv: Cast me not away from thy presence; And take not thy holy Spirit from me.

12.web: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
12.asv: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; And uphold me with a willing spirit.

13.web: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners shall be converted to you.
13.asv: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; And sinners shall be converted unto thee.

14.web: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.
14.asv: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation; Andmy tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

15.web: Lord, open my lips. My mouth shall declare your praise.
15.asv: O Lord, open thou my lips; And my mouth shall show forth thy praise.

16.web: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.
16.asv: For thou delightest not in sacrifice; else would I give it: Thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.

17.web: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
17.asv: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: A broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

18.web: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
18.asv: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: Build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

19.web: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.
19.asv: Then wilt thou delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, In burnt-offering and whole burnt-offering: Then will they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
